question: The Press and Periodicals Registration Bill, 2023 replaced which act with a simplified law that decriminalizes various provisions and brings digital media under its ambit?

options.text: Press and Registration of Books Act, 1867

solution:
The correct answer is __**Press and Registration of Books Act, 1867**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Press and Periodicals Registration Bill, 2023 **replaces the **Press and Registration of Books Act, 1867** with a simplified law.
 
• This new legislation **decriminalizes various provisions** that were part of the earlier act.
 
• It also brings digital media under its ambit</strong&g
